businesses.business: Oxford Industries apparel and lifestyle brands

offering_description.value: Designs, sources and markets apparel, footwear, accessories and home goods under several lifestyle brands, selling to department stores, specialty retailers and consumers through its own stores and online. It also operates a few restaurants tied to its brands.

primary_products.value: men's and women's apparel; footwear; accessories; home goods

customer_segment.value: B2B: department stores, specialty retailers, wholesale accounts; B2C: individual consumers buying in stores, online and at restaurants

end_markets.value: apparel retail; lifestyle and resort wear; hospitality

revenue_model.value: product sales: apparel and accessories sold wholesale and direct to consumers; licensing or royalties: brands licensed to partners for categories such as footwear and home; other: restaurant food and beverage sales
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; other

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets its own brands, using contract manufacturers, sold to retailers and consumers; retailer: runs its own stores and websites, selling finished goods to consumers

geography_served.value: North America: primarily United States, with stores and sales in Canada and licensing partners abroad

specialization.value: related lines: several apparel and lifestyle brands sharing sourcing, design and distribution

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: wholesale accounts with department and specialty stores; own locations: company-operated retail stores and restaurants; online: company e-commerce websites; partners / resellers: licensed partners selling footwear and home products
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; online; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product labeling and textile rules, consumer protection, and food service health codes for restaurants

notes: Current brand portfolio and any recent divestitures are uncertain, so the brand list was kept general.
